At IncubatorWorks, our PROGRAMS are at the heart of our mission—to support entrepreneurs every step of the way, from idea to launch and beyond. Programs that fit your needs Our programs are designed with your needs in mind, using a cohort-based model that fosters collaboration, accountability, and shared growth. Strategic business solutions The IncubatorWorks team takes a strategic approach to developing programs that empower entrepreneurs to grow their ideas, overcome challenges, and achieve long-term success. After five years, businesses that were nurtured in a business incubator have a survival rate of 87% – Tracy Kitts, COO of the National Business Incubation Association (NBIA) ( businessnewsdaily.com ) Co.Starters Business Accelerator Class This program accelerates the launch of your idea.
Get the tools, training, and mentorship you need to launch your small business with confidence.

Our 7-week Summer Youth Entrepreneurship Program is a summer employment opportunity that gives Elmira High School students the tools, mentorship, and real-world experience they need to bring a business idea to life.
You will participate in college, manufacturing, and industry field trips; hear from guest facilitators; and explore career pathways through hands-on learning.
Test out your idea: Use our equipment to learn whether a physical product is a good candidate for manufacturing.
Student teams work with industry and academic mentors to prepare a pitch, then compete for cash and in-kind prizes before a panel of judges.
